title: Pickup bar — an anacrusis and the bar that completes it
description: A one-beat pickup into 4/4, and a 3/4 last bar that completes it. The pickup is stored at its true length (`time` 1/4) and marked by `number: 0` on the first global measure — published MNX, no extension — so playback, swing, sync and entry all see a one-beat bar. Engraving shows what a printed copy does: 4/4 drawn once, at the pickup (the next bar's signature, "stolen"), nothing at bar 1, and no 3/4 on the short final bar; the bars number from the first full bar. Guitar Pro and MusicXML carry the same steal on the way out (roadmap/proposed/core-anacrusis.md). Pins the three views and the one-beat performance.
